newsitem.title: USA: Ford hires new marketing executive.
newsitem.headline: Ford hires new marketing executive.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said it hired James Schroer to be executive director of the company's newly created marketing strategy and brand management office.
Schroer was previously vice president and lead partner of consumer industries for the Booz, Allen and Hamilton consulting firm.
He will be responsible for corporate advertising, credit card operations, brand process strategy, the women's marketing office, advanced distribution strategy, and marketing research.

Schroer will report to Robert Rewey, group vice president of marketing and sales. Before Schroer joined Ford, brand management functions were handled by Ed Stedem, who retired six weeks ago, a company spokesman said.

With Schroer's appointment, Ford becomes the lastest automaker to bring an industry outsider into a senior marketing position. Two years ago, General Motors Corp hired Ronald Zarrella from Bausch & Lomb Inc as its top marketing executive.
